newsitem.title: USA: Group Technologies names Gill CEO.
newsitem.headline: Group Technologies names Gill CEO.

text.p: Group Technologies Corp said Monday that Robert Gill, previously chairman of the board from 1989 to 1992 and a director since 1989, will serve as chief executive officer, replacing Carl McCormick, who will retire at the end of the year.
The company said in a release Monday that the change in management is related to previously announced merger plans.
Group Technologies expects to merge with a new corporation to be formed by the Louisville, Ky.-based private holding company, Group Financial Partners Inc.
The company added that Gill was a founder and serves as chairman of Group Financial Partners.
